subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should maintainers accept the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression as a proof override, or require redacted live Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof before merge?
rationale: The code path is well covered at the manager level, but this is an external PR changing provider recovery on a real Gateway search path and the posted proof is explicitly mock-boundary only.

options.title: Require live Gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing memory_search fallback during primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic manager-level proof if the live provider harness cost is not worth blocking this bounded bug fix.

recommendation.title: Require live Gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing memory_search fallback during primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest memory provider-state history in the touched boundary and is the best routed owner for proof-sufficiency judgment.
